setup_batch_predict_server: deploy a Ray Serve BatchPredictServer with an MLIPPredictUnit for batched molecular inference
BatchPredictServer_predict: process a batch of AtomicData objects and return per-system prediction dictionaries
BatchPredictServer_configure_batching: configure the max batch size and wait timeout for the BatchPredictServer deployment
BatchPredictServer_split_predictions: split batched prediction tensors back into individual per-system prediction dictionaries
BatchPredictServer_get_predict_unit_attr: retrieve an attribute from the underlying MLIPPredictUnit by name
